statement:
The record gives an approved amount of USD 480,000 for claim CL-7712, but policy PL-40 caps payment at USD 50,000.
Claim CL-7712 paid USD 50,000, applying policy PL-40’s maximum limit.
judge_text:
WRONG

"The record gives an approved amount of USD 480,000 ... but policy PL-40 caps payment at USD 50,000" and pays the corrected USD 50,000.
